product.name: Nexus Verify
product.subtitle: Verify whether code-change evidence still applies to the exact current pull request.
product.description: Read-only evidence-applicability verification for public GitHub pull requests. Nexus Verify checks optional Nexus receipt integrity and current PR binding; it does not review code, execute repository code, write GitHub state, or authorize merge, release, or deployment.

default_prompts: Verify whether the evidence for this PR is still current.
Does this Nexus receipt apply to the current pull request?
The agent says this change is done. Verify the evidence.
listing.release_notes: Initial read-only public-review candidate for evidence applicability on public GitHub pull requests. One noauth tool; no UI; no private repository support; no write actions.

positive.prompt: Verify whether the evidence for https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/123 is still current.
positive.expected_boundary: Evidence result only; no merge/release/deploy approval.

positive.prompt: CI is green, but did the code change after verification on https://github.com/alpha/payments/pull/41?
positive.expected_boundary: Green checks alone do not become Nexus VERIFIED.

positive.prompt: Check whether the Nexus receipt for https://github.com/fleet/router/pull/66 was tampered with or is stale.
positive.expected_boundary: Tampered or stale evidence fails closed.

positive.prompt: Does the supplied verification evidence cover the changed-file scope of https://github.com/blue/worker/pull/11?
positive.expected_boundary: Scope mismatch must not be reported as applicable.

positive.prompt: Without rerunning repository code, verify the existing evidence for https://github.com/quiet/lib/pull/29.

negative.prompt: Review the code quality of https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/123.
negative.reason: Generic code review is outside Nexus Verify.

negative.prompt: Can https://github.com/snow/booking/pull/52 be merged now? Give me the approval decision.
negative.reason: Merge approval is outside Nexus Verify authority.
Deployment is outside Nexus Verify authority.
